name: review-fix
description: Four parallel reviewers (correctness, readability, maintainability, comments), oracle triages what to fix, one worker applies the fixes

parallel.label: Correctness
parallel.task:
Review the current changes for correctness and regressions: {task}

Inspect the actual diff and code. Report only evidence-backed findings with file/line references: bugs, broken edge cases, missing validation, failing paths. Do not modify project/source files; returning findings through the configured output artifact is allowed.

parallel.label: Readability
parallel.task:
Review the current changes for readability: {task}

Inspect the actual diff and code. Report only evidence-backed findings with file/line references: unclear names, confusing control flow, dead code. Do not modify project/source files; returning findings through the configured output artifact is allowed.

parallel.label: Maintainability
parallel.task:
Review the current changes for maintainability: {task}

Inspect the actual diff and code. Report only evidence-backed findings with file/line references: duplication, coupling, missing tests for changed behavior, hard-to-change structure. Do not modify project/source files; returning findings through the configured output artifact is allowed.

parallel.label: Comments
parallel.task:
Review the current changes for unnecessary comments: {task}

Inspect the actual diff and code. Report only evidence-backed findings with file/line references for comments that should be removed or trimmed:
- Restate what the next line already says
- Narrate the change ("fix bug", "add validation", "updated", "// implement X")
- Obvious from names/types/control flow
- Stale or wrong relative to the code

Do NOT flag comments that explain non-obvious intent, invariants, tradeoffs, external constraints, or why a surprising approach was chosen. Prefer delete over rewrite. Do not modify project/source files; returning findings through the configured output artifact is allowed.

chain.label: Decide fixes
Apply fixes
